omittedResponsibilities: Only the currently implemented concrete-item automatic character insertion branch is ported. SwFormatAutoFormat is non-shareable, retains explicitly supplied handles, copies the shared reference and compares pointer identity rather than item-set value equality. Registered save/open/recovery deviations and existing semantic statuses/defaults/exceptions remain unchanged.
